description: Two independent manual control voltage sources, each running -10V to +10V from a coarse and a fine knob

params.text: Sets the voltage of that section, -10V to +10V
Trims the voltage of that section, -0.5V to +0.5V, and is added to the coarse setting

outputs.text: Carries the sum of the coarse and fine knobs of that section, limited to -10V to +10V
